v_document_revision_sync_states.create_sql: CREATE TABLE "v_document_revision_sync_states" ("revision_id" varchar not null, "collab_protocol" varchar, "collab_state_format" varchar, "collab_state" blob, "collab_state_size" INTEGER CONSTRAINT v_document_revision_sync_states_protocol CHECK((collab_protocol IS NULL AND collab_state_format IS NULL AND collab_state IS NULL) OR (collab_protocol IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(collab_protocol, char(9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 32))) > 0 AND collab_state_format IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(collab_state_format, char(9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 32))) > 0)) CONSTRAINT v_document_revision_sync_states_binary_size CHECK((collab_state IS NULL AND collab_state_size IS NULL) OR (collab_state IS NOT NULL AND collab_state_size IS NOT NULL AND collab_state_size = length(CAST(collab_state AS BLOB)))) CONSTRAINT v_document_revision_sync_states_present CHECK(collab_protocol IS NOT NULL), foreign key("revision_id") references "v_document_revisions"("id") on delete cascade, primary key ("revision_id"))

v_document_sync_states.create_sql: CREATE TABLE "v_document_sync_states" ("document_id" varchar not null, "collab_protocol" varchar, "collab_state_format" varchar, "collab_state" blob, "collab_state_size" integer, "pending_protocol" varchar, "pending_state_format" varchar, "pending_schema_version" integer, "pending_generation" integer, "pending_through_seq" BIGINT CONSTRAINT v_document_sync_states_protocol CHECK((collab_protocol IS NULL AND collab_state_format IS NULL AND collab_state IS NULL) OR (collab_protocol IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(collab_protocol, char(9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 32))) > 0 AND collab_state_format IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(collab_state_format, char(9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 32))) > 0)) CONSTRAINT v_document_sync_states_binary_size CHECK((collab_state IS NULL AND collab_state_size IS NULL) OR (collab_state IS NOT NULL AND collab_state_size IS NOT NULL AND collab_state_size = length(CAST(collab_state AS BLOB)))) CONSTRAINT v_document_sync_states_present CHECK(collab_protocol IS NOT NULL OR pending_protocol IS NOT NULL) CONSTRAINT v_document_sync_states_pending CHECK((pending_protocol IS NULL AND pending_state_format IS NULL AND pending_schema_version IS NULL AND pending_generation IS NULL AND pending_through_seq IS NULL) OR (pending_protocol IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(pending_protocol, char(9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 32))) > 0 AND pending_state_format IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(pending_state_format, char(9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 32))) > 0 AND pending_schema_version IS NOT NULL AND typeof(pending_schema_version) = 'integer' AND pending_schema_version >= 1 AND pending_generation IS NOT NULL AND typeof(pending_generation) = 'integer' AND pending_generation >= 0 AND pending_through_seq IS NOT NULL AND typeof(pending_through_seq) = 'integer' AND pending_through_seq >= 1)), foreign key("document_id") references "v_documents"("id") on delete cascade, primary key ("document_id"))

v_scan_evidence.create_sql: CREATE TABLE "v_scan_evidence" ("id" varchar not null, "drive_id" varchar not null, "tenant_id" varchar, "spec_key" varchar not null, "scanner_key" varchar not null, "scanner_version" varchar not null, "policy_version" varchar not null, "revision_id" varchar not null, "blob_id" varchar, "scope_key" varchar not null, "content_identity" varchar not null, "sha256" varchar not null, "size_bytes" BIGINT CHECK(size_bytes IS NULL OR (typeof(size_bytes) = 'integer' AND size_bytes >= 0)) not null, "generation" BIGINT CHECK(generation IS NULL OR (typeof(generation) = 'integer' AND generation >= 1)) not null, "attempt" BIGINT CHECK(attempt IS NULL OR (typeof(attempt) = 'integer' AND attempt >= 1)) not null, "reason" varchar, "retryable" BOOLEAN CHECK(retryable IN (false, true)) not null default '0', "outcome" VARCHAR(16) CHECK(outcome IN ('clean','infected','failed')) CHECK(COALESCE((outcome IS NULL AND reason IS NULL AND retryable = false) OR (outcome IN ('clean','infected') AND reason IS NULL AND retryable = false AND blob_id IS NOT NULL) OR (outcome = 'failed' AND reason IS NOT NULL), false)) not null, "obligation_id" varchar not null, "request_id" varchar not null, "observed_at" datetime not null, "reused_from_id" varchar, "revoked_at" datetime, "revocation_reason" varchar, foreign key("drive_id") references "v_drives"("id") on delete cascade, foreign key("revision_id") references "v_file_revisions"("id") on delete cascade, foreign key("blob_id") references "v_blobs"("id") on delete restrict, foreign key("obligation_id") references "v_scan_obligations"("id") on delete cascade, foreign key("request_id") references "v_scan_requests"("id") on delete cascade, foreign key("reused_from_id") references "v_scan_evidence"("id") on delete set null, primary key ("id"))

v_scan_obligations.create_sql: CREATE TABLE "v_scan_obligations" ("id" varchar not null, "drive_id" varchar not null, "tenant_id" varchar, "spec_key" varchar not null, "scanner_key" varchar not null, "scanner_version" varchar not null, "policy_version" varchar not null, "revision_id" varchar not null, "blob_id" varchar, "scope_key" varchar not null, "content_identity" varchar not null, "sha256" varchar not null, "size_bytes" BIGINT CHECK(size_bytes IS NULL OR (typeof(size_bytes) = 'integer' AND size_bytes >= 0)) not null, "generation" BIGINT CHECK(generation IS NULL OR (typeof(generation) = 'integer' AND generation >= 1)) not null, "attempt" BIGINT CHECK(attempt IS NULL OR (typeof(attempt) = 'integer' AND attempt >= 0)) not null, "reason" varchar, "retryable" BOOLEAN CHECK(retryable IN (false, true)) not null default '0', "outcome" VARCHAR(16) CHECK(outcome IN ('clean','infected','failed')) CHECK(COALESCE((outcome IS NULL AND reason IS NULL AND retryable = false) OR (outcome IN ('clean','infected') AND reason IS NULL AND retryable = false AND blob_id IS NOT NULL) OR (outcome = 'failed' AND reason IS NOT NULL), false)), "request_key" varchar not null, "state" VARCHAR(16) CHECK(state IN ('pending','leased','retry_wait','settled')) not null default 'pending', "available_at" datetime not null, "lease_token" varchar, "lease_expires_at" TIMESTAMP CHECK((state = 'leased' AND lease_token IS NOT NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL) OR (state <> 'leased' AND lease_token IS NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NULL)) CHECK(state <> 'settled' OR outcome IS NOT NULL), "last_published_at" datetime, "created_at" datetime, "updated_at" datetime, foreign key("drive_id") references "v_drives"("id") on delete cascade, foreign key("revision_id") references "v_file_revisions"("id") on delete cascade, foreign key("blob_id") references "v_blobs"("id") on delete restrict, primary key ("id"))
